rounds.text: Aditya Consumer Marketing Ltd exhibits a persistent pattern of value destruction, evidenced by a negative return on equity of -10.85% and a negative return on assets of -8.6% [E7, E8]. The company’s long-term growth trajectory is stagnant, with compounded sales growth over the last five years at -1% and a three-year compounded share price decline of -19% [E14, E20]. Despite the recent focus on profit growth, the business remains fundamentally inefficient, as shown by a negative ROCE of -6.34% and a low interest coverage ratio [E9, E44]. Furthermore, the company is trading at 2.96 times its book value, a premium that is difficult to justify given the consistent failure to generate positive shareholder returns [E43, E46]. Borrowings have increased to Rs 5.92 Cr, and the company continues to report negative free cash flow of Rs -0.42 Cr [E32, E34]. Conceded: the company has seen a recent improvement in quarterly operating margins and a 44% increase in compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E17, E27].
